# Axe Spoofer A modern LSPosed module for spoofing Android device identifiers. ![Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-10%2B-green) ![LSPosed](https://img.shields.io/badge/LSPosed-Compatible-blue) ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-v1.0.0-purple) > ⚠️ This project is intended for research, development, testing, and educational purposes only. --- ## Features - Android ID Spoofing - GSF ID Spoofing - Advertising ID (Ads ID) Spoofing - App Set ID Spoofing - Media DRM ID Spoofing - Device Fingerprint Management - Hide Email Address - Random Identifier Generator - Per-app Spoofing Support --- ## Requirements - Android 10+ - Root Access - LSPosed Framework --- ## Download Download the latest version from the **[Releases](../../releases)** page. --- ## Installation 1. Download the latest APK from the **Releases** page. 2. Install the application. 3. Enable the module in **LSPosed** and select the target apps. 4. Reboot your device. 5. Open Axe Spoofer and configure the identifiers you want to spoof. --- ## Screenshots

By using this software, you agree that you are solely responsible for your actions and for complying with all applicable laws and the terms of service of any third-party applications or services. --- ## Credits Developed by **@IH4xCode** Special thanks to: - LSPosed Team - Android Open Source Project (AOSP) GitHub: https://github.com/iH4xCode --- ## Support Found a bug or have a feature request? Feel free to contact me: Email: When reporting an issue, please include: - Device model - Android version - LSPosed version - App version - Steps to reproduce the issue - Screenshots or logs (if available) Your feedback and suggestions are always welcome. ---
